Daljingga, banjibume arara toose jai licence
Nirugan nonggifi, šoyobuha nirugan be ubade tatara

Android i bithe sonjore agūra be baitalafi 20 nirugan de isitala nonggici ombi. Fejergi tray de provider buhe oci šoyobuha nirugan, bithe i gebu, crop i amba ajige jai bithe dasabuha erin iletulembi. Bithe i gebu eici dasabuha erin de acabume ilibuci ombi; ilibureci aifini sindaha nirugan i ba halarakū.

Šoyobuha nirugan be darafi sonjombi. Crop image tere nirugan be fafulambi; Batch crop sonjoho nirugan de pixel eici percent i dulimbai ba be emu mudan de baitalambi. Crop handle be tatara eici ton be dosimbu. Reset crop daci dalba de bederembi. Crop oci daci bithe be halarakū, bederebuci ombi.

Šoyobuha nirugan be jafafi tatara, eici baita ba de sindaha nirugan be tatara, iletulehe dalba de sinda. Hacihiyaha doigomšoro nirugan adali obure ba be yargiyan i tuwabumbi. Ici ergi de holbobuci dergi dalba be acabumbi; fejergi de holbobuci hashū dalba be acabumbi. Šoyobuha nirugan be darafi + target be daraci inu ombi. Ujui nirugan oci origin de deribumbi. Ejen nirugan be crop seci, tuttu holboho nirugan inu gurimbi. Nirugan be acabume dabališaci ojorakū.

Same width jai Same height oci nirugan emgeri beye i aspect ratio be tuwakiyame, eiten dosimbuha nirugan de emu adali amba ajige bure. Pixels, percent, Smallest eici Largest be sonjo. Restore original sizes oci damu adali obuha amba ajige be bederebumbi, crop be bibumbi.

Unplace oci damu sonjoho nirugan be tray de bederembi. Amargi nirugan akū ba be duibulembi, tuttu sindaha songko be bibumbi. Remove oci tere dosimbuha nirugan be teile meitembi. Undo/Redo de ere kūbulin be bederebuci ombi. Sindaha nirugan be tatara de ilibun be halambi; untuhun ba be tatara de tuwabun gurimbi. Juwe anggala be baitalafi zoom. Show all changes oci yooni nirugan acabun be tuwabure adali zoom sembi, output i amba ajige be halarakū.

Save PNG oci acabuhangge nirugan be PNG seme bibumbi. Edit in Paint oci main editor de unggifi bederebuci ojoro nirugan halan seme arambi. Output memori budget be tucibuci, ajige output copy be sonjo. Daci bithe halarakū. Te i assembly be kikay de bibufi, si dahame dosirede neimbi.

Ere mode de main editor i Help dorgi Catrobat/AGPL jai asset credit adali baitalambi.

Toolbar fejergi hashū ergi de an sirdan agūra be hūwalimbi eici bederembi: dergi ergi oci hūwalimbi, fejergi ergi oci selgiyembi. Portrait de tool strip toolbar fejergi de sampes yabuha; swipe arame ele agūra de genere. Landscape de hashū ergi de bi. Brush duwalibun de Pencil, Brush, Watercolor jai Airbrush bi. Selection duwalibun de durbeme jai cihai arbun sonjon bi. Insert duwalibun de šu, arbun jai gisun bi. Duwalibun be daraci portrait de strip fejergi, landscape de ici ergi de agūra jai setting be selgiyembi. Dahūme daraci hūwalimbi; sirdan ubaliyambi. Duwalibun be baitalaha amala agūra be ejelembi. Options panel be scroll arame ele setting jai edit control be tuwara. Ere layout be ujui neire de juwe panel yooni selgiyebuhe; amala sonjonggo be ejelembi. Landscape de dergi control emu row de bithe gebu dulimba de bi; Menu de File, Edit, View, Image, Colors jai Help be neimbi, eiten de Android submenu sirdan bi.

FG/BG boco temgetu fejergi hashū de palette i hanci toktoho bi. Palette tere row de ici ergi de neimbi. Tere sirdan ici dalba de bi: hashū ergi de hūwalimbi, ici ergi de selgiyembi. Hūwalirede extra swatch be somibufi temgetu gurirakū. Boco box be daraci palette be inu halambi. Swatch be daraha oci julergi boco, jafaha oci amargi boco. FG/BG de Palette, Honeycomb jai Advanced neimbi. Advanced de spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL jai 6-bit hex control bi. Umesi ici ergi duin cell hanciki boco be bibumbi; daraha oci julergi, jafaha oci amargi boco. Beye i boco i ujui Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 jai Copper #B87333. Beye i swatch be jafafi halara. Main editor opaque boco be baitalambi; transparent import be te BG boco dergi de sindambi. Daci bithe halarakū.

Navigate oci fe magnifier agūra be alimbi: emu anggala de tatara de pan, juwe anggala de pinch arame zoom jai pan. Navigate be dahūme darara eici Draw again be darara de nirure de bederembi. Nirure agūra de inu juwe anggala de pan arame nirugan temgetu be sindarakū. Fejergi ici slider de 100% dulimba šu bi. Zoom in/out button emu mudan de 100% be tucibuci neneme 100% de tehebi; dahūme daraha manggi yabumbi. Hanci Fit button nirure hūwa be tuwabun de acabufi dulimba sindambi. View de 100% jai pixel grid inu bi.

Autosave oci edit majige nakaha manggi jai app ci tuheke de te draft be ejelembi. Status de Draft saved eici autosave tašan iletulembi. Dahūme neirede draft, bithe gebu, agūra setting, floating sonjon jai wajihakū arbun be bederembi. Autosave beyei working draft be bibumbi. File de PNG, quality halaci mutere JPEG jai HEIC, lossless eici lossy JPEG XL, WebP jai AVIF bi. Save and share Android sharing be neire onggolo bithe be bibumbi. Export sonjoho ba de bibu; bithe gebu i usiha oci export bithe de bibuhakū kūbulin bisire be alambi. Autosave daci nirugan be karmame halarakū.

Sonjon: durbeme eici cihai arbun dalba be nirure. Dorgi be tatara de gurimbi, square mujilen eici dalba dulimba handle be tatara de amba ajige halambi, fiyangga Rotate handle be tatara de forgošombi. Lock proportions oci daci neire; nakaci jušuru jai ondo be beye beye halaci ombi. Dalba handle damu sonjoho dalba i ergi de amba ajige halambi. Cihai sonjon forgošoho eici autosave manggi inu transform box dorgi arbun be bibumbi. Amba ajige jai angle sidebar de iletulembi. Commit selection result be emu bederebuci ojoro edit seme baitalambi; autosave wajihakū transform be bibumbi. Copy, Cut jai Crop to selection transform nirugan be baitalambi. Select all edit icon i jai row de bi, external keyboard de Ctrl+A inu baitalaci ombi. Cut/Copy jai Paste/Select all How to use fejergi juwe row ne. Sonjon mask sonjoho arbun be bibumbi; document beye opaque bi.

Nirure hūwa i dalba: handle be dorgi tatara de fafulambi, tule tatara de selgiyembi, amala Apply bounds be dara. Ice ba BG be baitalambi; aifini pixel scale ararakū. Cancel jai Undo baitalaci ombi. Resize image, Canvas size jai New image inu Pixels eici Percent be alimbi, aspect lock sonjoci ombi.

Curve: emu šu be nirufi juwe mudan tatara de wariyambumbi. Polygon: mujilen se be darara, wajima mujilen be juwe mudan darara eici Finish polygon be baitalara. Close polygon be nakaci holboho neire šu be niruci ombi. Rounded rectangle: slider de Radius (px) be toktobu; radius durbe i ajige dalba i juwe i emu de isitala. Text: nirure hūwa be darara, beye i arbun de iletulehe hergen arbun be sonjofi live preview be baitalara. Setting de amba ajige, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing jai BG text box bi. Watercolor Brush duwalibun de Brush jai Airbrush hanci bi; Strength be halafi nimanggi šu arara. Pencil, brush jai agūra i amba ajige slider 100 pixel de isitala. Pencil 1 pixel ci deribufi beye i jušuru be ejelembi. Iletulehe ton be darafi yargiyan ton dosimbuci ombi. Heart, Star jai Arrow de gūwa arbun adali dalba/tebure sonjon bi. View > Cursor drawing de neire/nakara, cursor arbun jai magnifier setting be selgiyembi. Cursor ba be toktobure de tatara, screen drawing button be darara, amala pan arame nirure. Dahūme darafi nakara. Brush jai stroke setting Draw > Drawing de bi. View > Magnified preview de cursor eici nirure ba be halaci mutere ambalabun de iletulembi. Drawing settings de antialiasing jai stroke smoothing inu bi. Gūwa 10 hergen arbun baktambi; Font licences de gebulehe baita jai yooni terms bi.

File > Load image Android picker deri nirure hūwa be halambi. Insert image into canvas nirugan be floating sonjon seme dosimbumbi. Fejergi Catrobat sticker gallery online nirugan bure; wasimbuci ojoro nirugan be darara eici jafara de dosimbumbi. Help > Image credits da holboro futa jai licence alara gisun be bibumbi. Kikay memori budget de acabure nirugan daci resolution de dosimbi. Baitalaci, resize-choice dialog de amba ajige, pixel ton jai memori bodon be iletulefi, Pixels/Percent jai aspect lock be sonjoci ombi. Daci bithe halarakū.

File eici View > Image assembly emu faksaha workspace be neifi 20 nirugan de isitala baitalambi. Šoyobuha nirugan be bithe gebu eici erin de ilibure. Emu nirugan crop eici labdu nirugan batch-crop. Same width / Same height yooni dosimbuha nirugan i amba ajige be aspect ratio be bibume adali obumbi. Šoyobuha nirugan eici sindaha nirugan be tatara de ici/dergi acabure eici fejergi/hashū acabure. Unplace damu sonjoho ilibun be meitefi akū ba be duibulembi. Show all changes damu tuwabun i zoom be halambi. Save PNG assembly be tucibumbi; Edit in Paint bederebuci ojoro edit seme main editor de unggimbi. App emu opaque nirugan editor be baitalambi. Image assembly oci gūwa ilibure workspace.
